"It doesn’t change anything as far as our standing going forward in the postseason, but it's still a nice feather in our cap to win 100 games," Dodgers manager Dav
title: Dodgers eye three-peat as MLB playoffs begin

description: Jeonghan and Joshua of Seventeen will have concerts in six cities across Asia starting with a three-night show in Incheon, Korea next month, according to agency Pledis Entertainment on Monday. The duo is kicking off tour “Journey into Dreaming” on Oct. 30 at Inspire Arena, and will visit Saitama, Japan, Macao, Taipei, Busan, Korea and Hong Kong until mid-February. The concert trip is based on the first EP “Dreamscape” the pair will bring out on Oct. 19. Teaser photographs to promote the mini alb
title: Seventeen’s Jeonghan X Joshua to launch 6-city tour

The Samsung Electronics affiliate said Monday it would invest 4.27 trillion won ($3,2 billion) in its Sejong plant through May 2028 to expand production of flip chip-ball grid array substrates, or FC-BGAs, which are used in AI accelerators and other high-per
title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics W6.78tr buildout gets customer backing

description: The first solo single from Jungkook of BTS has garnered the eighth most streams on Spotify among songs from the 2020s, according to the platform’s ranking. His “Seven (feat. Latto)” climbed up three spots from last year, and is the only song from an Asian artist among the top 10. The 2023 single has amassed close to 3.1 billion plays, ranking No. 69 in overall streams on Spotify. It has stormed past major milestones, including 100 million and 1 billion streams in record amounts of time on the pl
title: BTS’ Jungkook's 'Seven' ranks at No. 8 on Spotify’s most-streamed 2020s songs list

description: President Lee Jae Myung on Tuesday called for a thorough investigation to determine the truth behind a mine blast inside the Demilitarized Zone last week that injured three South Korean soldiers. Lee made the remark during a Cabinet meeting at Cheong Wa Dae, a day after the military announced preliminary findings that the explosion likely had been caused by North Korean mines. Lee vowed to take necessary measures and offered his consolation to the injured troops while wishing their full recovery
title: Lee calls for thorough probe of mine blast, vows necessary measures

description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday the United States will restrict visa issuance to those responsible for impeding the resolution of international parental child abduction cases as a US report has accused South Korea and other countries of showing a "pattern of noncompliance" with a multilateral treaty. Rubio issued a statement on the restriction, highlighting that protecting American children abducted across international borders and reuniting them with their parents is a "top" prior
title: US to restrict visa issuance to those impeding resolution of int'l parental child abduction: Rubio

description: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang received an annual prestigious award for his contribution to enhancing the relationship between South Korea and the United States, a nonprofit organization said Monday. Huang was honored with this year's Van Fleet Award in recognition of his "visionary" leadership and "transformative" contributions to the artificial intelligence and semiconductor industries -- sectors central to the deepening economic partnership between the two countries, accord
title: Nvidia CEO Huang receives this year's Van Fleet Award for contribution to S. Korea-US relations

description: South Korea took a 4-1 beating against Uruguay in their men's football friendly match in Seoul on Monday, the team's first loss under their temporary head coach Robert Moreno. Darwin Nunes and Giorgian de Arrascaeta each scored a goal, in the 13th minute and then 27th minute, for Uruguay at Seoul World Cup Stadium in the nation's capital, with South Korean defender Kim Min-jae being charged with an own goal late in the first half. title: S. Korea fall to Uruguay for 1st loss under Moreno

title: N. Korea prepares to deploy another 10,000 troops to Russia: Zelenskyy

description: North Korean land mines were highly likely the cause of a recent mine explosion inside the Demilitarized Zone, South Korea's military has said, vowing to hold Pyongyang "fully" accountable and take corresponding measures if confirmed. The military announced its preliminary findings from its joint investigation with the UN Command on Monday, hours after revisiting the site of last Monday's explosion inside the DMZ separating the two Koreas. The blast left two South Korean soldiers severely injure
title: N. Korean land mines highly likely cause of DMZ blast: S. Korean military

description: North Korea on Tuesday accused the United States of driving the global nuclear order into "the worst crisis" through its "nuclear proliferation activities" and used the accusation to defend its own nuclear program. The accusation came in a foreign ministry's "memorandum" carried by the Korean Central News Agency, hours after Vice Foreign Minister Kim Son-gyong told the UN General Assembly in New York that North Korea's nuclear program is an "irresistible" force needed to protect its sovereignty
title: N. Korea blames US for 'worse crisis' in nuclear order, justifies its arsenal

description: South Korean stocks opened lower Tuesday, tracking Wall Street losses as rising oil prices fueled inflation concerns and lifted US Treasury yields amid tensions in the Middle East. The benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index, or KOSPI, fell 13.31 points, or 0.19 percent, to 6,876.43 as of 9:15 a.m. Overnight, US stocks retreated as renewed tensions between the United States and Iran drove crude oil prices higher, fueling concerns that higher energy costs could keep inflation and interest rat
title: Seoul stocks open lower on inflation woes

description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has ordered an assessment of proposals to distribute more money to national associations following calls from UEFA and CONCACAF for a $2.1 billion payout from the governing body's reserves, but stopped short of committing to an amount. title: Infantino orders funding reviews for $2.1b payout to federations
